dogecoin.text:
— 🇺🇸 NEW: The official U.S. government website of the Department of Government Efficiency has gone live, featuring nothing but a logo of the Dogecoin cryptocurrency

The logo itself showcases the Shiba Inu dog, 'Kabosu,' who passed away at the age of 18 last year. https://t.co/JuUgBAxOMC
